notes.title: Viviette Release Date: 18 October 2018
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Our upcoming new game, [b]Viviette[/b], now has an official release date:

[h1]18 October 2018[/h1]

Well, that's next week, on Thursday!

Viviette is an [b]exploration-puzzle[/b] game with touches of [b]classic horror[/b]. We highly recommend avoiding any kind of spoliers before playing the game, so that you can enjoy the full experience your own way. We think the game is super immersive from start to end.

In adversity, you should persevere. But if you get stuck in the game, just ask for help in the project's [url=steamcommunity.com/app/883070/discussions/]discussions forum[/url]. We won't reply, but surely other players will do. We will only reply to bug reports or technical issues, though we think the game is bug free.

Meanwhile, adding it to your [b]wishlist[/b] will help with visibility before launch:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/883070/Viviette/

Thanks for reading!

[i]Alberto & Dani[/i]

notes.title: Update v3.0 - Lots of fixes!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9148364/3d5af5572d2286ccb9276082b18bf1cf1fc6278e.gif[/img]

Finally!

After so long, we have been able to recover [b]Super Star Path[/b] base code, so we have fixed / improved a lot of stuff! For the moment, these changes are only available for [b]Windows[/b]. We will update Mac and Linux builds probably next month.

[h1]Changes in v3.0[/h1]

- [b]New game engine.[/b] The game code now matches our current game engine, so maintaining this project won't be a pain anymore.

- The game now uses [b]DirectX 11[/b], and we have also improved overall [b]performance[/b].

- [b]New options UI.[/b] We have implemented a more functional options menu, and now you can [b]customize keyboard and gamepad controls[/b]. Also, menu navigation is more intuitive.

- [b]Difficulty modes.[/b] Now you can select the difficulty level that better suits your needs. Three modes available: Easy, Normal and Hard.

- [b]Improved procedural level generator.[/b] You should always find a path... if you choose the right path, obviously! It's a puzzle game after all, so you need to know the rules and select your next target carefully!

- [b]Higher quality sound[/b]. We have increased the bitrate at which music and sound is encoded, with no much impact on download size.

- [b]Removed the on-screen radio text message[/b]. The pilot still talks (you can disable this), but the text message won't bother you anymore during boss fights.

- Some [b]visual improvements[/b] on sprite animation, smooth parallax scroll, etc.

- Many bug fixes and adjustments.

[h1]Support[/h1]

If you have any [b]issue[/b] with this new version, let us know in the [url=steamcommunity.com/app/375120/discussions/]forums[/url].

Thanks for supporting this little game!

[i]Alberto & Dani[/i]
